scenario: A `call` kwarg with a runtime expression (binding-slot arithmetic) reaches the integrator's cb as a typed argument holding the computed value: the compiler lowers it to a name/value operand pair on FN_CALL (RDSC.4a.9.4), and libds's call bridge hands it over as a `ds_arg_t`. A call with no `as` carries the correlation the compiler generates per activation, `$r_c0_g0` for this rule's first call firing once (LCRS.3.1, LCCO.3.4). Pins [LGRA.10.6] (a computed kwarg), [RLOW.7.3.1] (the runtime evaluates each argument to its kind) and [NCBK.6.2] / [NCBK.6.10] (one typed argument per kwarg): t.v = 21 reaches the callback as x = 42. The ICOM.22.4 in its id is no clause: no document carries the ICOM prefix.
rules_ds:
service svc.do:
    kwarg x: Int
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.do x: (t.v * 2) nocooldown
